segments.name: Hibernating / Lost
segments.strategy: Low-cost reactivation campaigns only (broad discount emails, re-engagement sequences); avoid heavy investment.
segments.rationale: Long recency and low frequency/monetary value -- the economics rarely justify expensive win-back tactics here.

segments.name: Champions
segments.strategy: Loyalty & advocacy programs, early access to new products, VIP tiers, referral incentives.
segments.rationale: Highest recency, frequency, and monetary value. Retention cost here is far lower than acquisition cost elsewhere, and this group has the highest referral potential.

segments.name: At-Risk High Value
segments.strategy: Personalized win-back campaigns, time-limited offers, direct outreach (email/call), satisfaction surveys.
segments.rationale: High historical spend but rising recency (drifting away). Losing this group has an outsized revenue impact, so proactive intervention has strong expected ROI.
